initiative.title: Landing and docs entry paths
initiative.summary: Act on the 2026-10-15 landing/docs Pro review: lead with linked exploration, expose local, database, notebook, team and React routes, and fix onboarding.

sources.location: npm view exploreda; git log exploreda@0.2.0..main

claims.statement: Landing leads with linked exploration (option B): broader data noun, file/example CTAs, early workflow routes; browser and CLI analysts first.
Implement the important parts now; the question rounds set the cut line.
The landing page gets a full redesign pass, not only copy and new sections.
Write four walkthroughs now: local folder, database, notebook, team server. File and React walkthroughs are below the line.
Every walkthrough step is executed on local example data before merge; failures become fixes or copy changes.
Order: claim fixes and copy/routes first, then one redesign pass covering the landing page and the docs home path entry.
Hero: Open a file, Try an example, plus a copyable npx exploreda command; database, notebook, team and React routes sit below the demo; React install moves to a developer section.
Walkthroughs are verified from source on main; each PR carries its changeset and the public site catches up with the next release (npm 0.2.0 is 116 commits behind main).
The redesign is built straight through and reviewed via PR screenshots at three widths; no comp checkpoint.
Out: file and React walkthroughs, landing proof strip, search-metadata tuning, replacing the order-book example, new demo datasets, sidebar restructure, and the product expansions in REC-14.

shape.appetite: Six stacked PRs on PR #430; docs/landing work plus small fixes walkthroughs reveal; no new demo system, datasets, or navigation structure.
shape.problem: The landing page and docs home present CSV exploration and React embedding while the product also runs as a CLI project, team server, database snapshots, and notebooks; their docs bury first steps and some claims overreach.
shape.recommended_shape: Run the four tasks first; fix claims; settle hero (file, example, npx exploreda) and five workflow routes plus a docs-home path panel; add run-verified walkthroughs for local folder, database, notebook, team; then redesign landing and docs home.
success_moves: Run the four tasks from main before writing route copy, so copy only promises verified paths.
Add npx exploreda --example forecast instead of sending notebook readers to the repository.
Link routes to page tops first and repoint each to its walkthrough anchor as that walkthrough lands, keeping every PR shippable.
Prove the team trial path with --seed-dev before introducing Docker; build the image from source rather than relying on ghcr 0.2.0.
Redesign last over fixed content so the PR is reviewable from screenshots and reverts cleanly.

first_proof.question: Do the local-folder, database, notebook, and team-server tasks work from main as the docs describe them today?
first_proof.artifact: Per-step pass/fail run record in M1 evidence, with failing output.
first_proof.decision_rule: A passing path gets its route and walkthrough as planned; a failing step gets fixed in its walkthrough milestone, or its route links the docs without a walkthrough promise until it passes.

rabbit_holes: A walkthrough exposes a product bug larger than a patch.
Docs describe main while npm is 0.2.0.
